source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
When you are ready to search, click Ctrl-Ctrl.
3. Inspect each dwelling. Set aside any that appear habitable.
4. Inspect each of the non-habitable dwellings.
5. Record the inspection findings.
6. Record the maintenance recommendations.
7. Record the follow-up inspection and the recommended timing.

  1. The recommended timing is determined by the level of risk to occupants and visitors, as follows:

    1. High – within seven days.
    2. Medium – within 14 days.
    3. Low – within 28 days.

8. Read back the recommendations at the end of the inspection.
9. Sign off that the inspection has been performed and the results have been recorded.
10. Perform the inspections every six months.
